method: Google Trends daily search interest in Boston DMA (Nielsen 506) over the 90 days before each event (before the build date for events still to come).
Every request includes "TD Garden"; a term's score is 100 x its mean / TD Garden's mean in the same request, so scores compare across requests (TD Garden = 100).

For precision, terms are compared with the smallest anchor of the ladder Agganis Arena, TD Garden, Red Sox that they don't squash below a mean of 4.0; each anchor's ratio to TD Garden is measured in its own request in the same window.

A game is scored by its opponent's term (the home team's is the same for every home game and mostly tracks the season); other events by their biggest term's score plus half of the others' (headliner plus support). Terms below Trends' threshold score 0.05.
Events without a score (no terms, Trends unreachable or rate limited) are marked source "prior" and use their kind's prior in the attendance model.
